(async()=>{ const L=window.__wolLearn, $=(s)=>document.querySelector('#wol-learn '+s), sleep=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms)); const rounds=[]; for (let k=0;k<4;k++){ L._go('quiz',{level:'hard',biome:'grove'}); await sleep(80); const seen=[]; for (let i=0;i<10;i++){ const q=$('.wl-q'); seen.push(q?q.textContent:'?'); const o=$('.wl-opt'); o&&o.click(); await sleep(30); const n=$('.wl-fb [data-wl=next]'); n&&n.click(); await sleep(30);} rounds.push(seen);} const all=rounds.flat(); const dup=all.length-new Set(all).size; const st=L._state(); return 'rounds '+rounds.length+' asked '+all.length+' repeats '+dup+' seen '+(st.seen||[]).length; })()
